rules.description: Illinois Paid Leave for All Workers Act

value.statute: Paid Leave for All Workers Act
value.localOrdinanceCarveOut: Employers covered by a paid leave ordinance in force before 1 Jan 2024 (City of Chicago, Cook County) are not subject to PLAWA where that ordinance requires paid leave

source.title: Illinois Department of Labor — Paid Leave for All Workers Act FAQ

versions.notes: PLAWA leave may be used for any reason. Frontloading allowed. Pending bill HB5128 (2026) not enacted as of verification.

versions.notes: IDOL lists $15.00 for 1/1/2025 and 1/1/2026. Youth (<18, <650h) $13.00 and tipped rates not modelled.
